text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are declining in tandem at -2.4%, suggesting a broad pullback rather than sector rotation, while altcoins like BNB are falling harder at -4.8%, indicating risk-off pressure on smaller-cap assets. Despite the price dips, the Fear & Greed Index remains elevated at 69 and rising, paired with Bitcoin's dominant 58.6% market share, implying investors are holding conviction in the majors rather than panicking. Volume at $94B is moderate, consistent with a consolidation phase rather than a capitulation sell-off.
